description: Use for "which NFL games are mispriced on Kalshi" and "NFL win total, MVP or Super Bowl edges". Our NFL model vs live Kalshi prices — this week's game positions, season win totals, MVP and championship odds: model probability, price, edge and side. tickers[] checks a watchlist (futures, mvp, championship). Pro — sign in with PredictionMarketsPicks, or a Pro API key.

limit.description: Max rows (default 10). Values above 25 are clamped to 25.

market.description: game = this week moneyline edges; futures = season win totals; mvp = KXNFLMVP; championship = playoff/conference/Super Bowl.

minEdge.description: Minimum absolute edge in pp (default 4) — futures / mvp / championship only; game rows are the published positions. Ignored when tickers[] is passed. Accepts a number or a numeric string ("3", "3pp", "3%").

tickers.description: Optional Kalshi ticker watchlist (up to 25) — e.g. paste the tickers from your Kalshi Pro screener or Canvas to get PMP's edge on exactly those markets. Full market or 3-segment event tickers both work. Tickers PMP doesn't model are returned as not_covered (never a fabricated edge).

name: nfl_edge
title: NFL Edge (model vs Kalshi)
